Cosori TurboBlaze air fryer (CAF-DC601S, bypassV2 startCook).

Single chamber; times are in seconds. A preheat is sent only when the device map has the PREHEAT feature, otherwise preheat_time is dropped with a debug log. stop(), resume() and cook_from_preheat() are not implemented and return False. The reported currentTemp is in Celsius and is converted to temp_unit. A local set_mode() does not set state.recipe. A failed poll, an unknown cookStatus or an out-of-range stepIndex leaves the state unchanged.

Source code in src/pyvesync/devices/vesynckitchen.py 
class VeSyncTurboBlazeFryer(BypassV2Mixin, VeSyncFryer):
    """Cosori TurboBlaze air fryer (CAF-DC601S, bypassV2 ``startCook``).

    Single chamber; times are in seconds. A preheat is sent only when the
    device map has the ``PREHEAT`` feature, otherwise ``preheat_time`` is
    dropped with a debug log. ``stop()``, ``resume()`` and
    ``cook_from_preheat()`` are not implemented and return False. The reported
    ``currentTemp`` is in Celsius and is converted to ``temp_unit``. A local
    ``set_mode()`` does not set ``state.recipe``. A failed poll, an unknown
    ``cookStatus`` or an out-of-range ``stepIndex`` leaves the state unchanged.
    """

    __slots__ = ()

    def _payload_update(self) -> dict | None:
        """Return extra payload keys sent on every request, if any."""
        return None

    def _cook_request_dict(
        self, recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe
    ) -> dict[str, int | str | bool | dict]:
        """Build the startCook data values from a recipe."""
        cook_req: dict[str, int | str | bool | dict] = {}
        cook_req['accountId'] = self.manager.account_id
        if recipe.preheat_time is not None and recipe.preheat_time > 0:
            cook_req['hasPreheat'] = int(True)
        cook_req['hasWarm'] = False
        cook_req['mode'] = recipe.cook_mode
        # readyStart False starts the cook at once; True waits for the start button.
        cook_req['readyStart'] = False
        cook_req['recipeId'] = recipe.recipe_id
        cook_req['recipeName'] = recipe.recipe_name
        cook_req['recipeType'] = recipe.recipe_type
        cook_req['tempUnit'] = self.temp_unit.code
        cook_req['startAct'] = {
            'cookSetTime': self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.cook_time),
            'cookTemp': recipe.target_temp,
            'preheatTemp': recipe.target_temp if recipe.preheat_time else 0,
            'shakeTime': 0,
        }
        return cook_req

    def _build_cook_request(self, recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe) -> RequestBaseModel:
        return models.FryerTurboBlazeRequestData.from_dict(
            self._cook_request_dict(recipe)
        )

    async def get_details(self) -> None:
        resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
            payload_method='getAirfryerStatus',
            payload_update=self._payload_update(),
        )
        resp_model = process_bypassv2_result(
            self,
            logger,
            'get_details',
            resp,
            models.FryerTurboBlazeDetailResult,
        )

        if resp_model is None:
            return

        # Standby responses report the unit too (P583S-KUS capture).
        if resp_model.tempUnit:
            self.temp_unit = resp_model.tempUnit

        if (
            resp_model.cookStatus == AirFryerCookStatus.STANDBY.value
            or not resp_model.stepArray
        ):
            self.state.set_standby()
            return

        if resp_model.cookStatus not in self.status_map:
            logger.warning(
                'Unknown cook status %s for %s, keeping the last state',
                resp_model.cookStatus,
                self.device_name,
            )
            return

        if not 0 <= resp_model.stepIndex < len(resp_model.stepArray):
            logger.warning(
                'stepIndex %s out of range for %s steps on %s, keeping the last state',
                resp_model.stepIndex,
                len(resp_model.stepArray),
                self.device_name,
            )
            return

        cook_step = resp_model.stepArray[resp_model.stepIndex]

        # currentTemp from the bypassV2 getAirfryerStatus response is the
        # device's hardware sensor reading, which the firmware always
        # reports in Celsius regardless of the reported tempUnit. The
        # tempUnit field governs only the echoed cookTemp/preheatTemp
        # values. Normalize so consumers can compare cook_temp and
        # current_temp without a unit-aware crutch.
        _current_temp = resp_model.currentTemp
        if _current_temp is not None and self.temp_unit == TemperatureUnits.FAHRENHEIT:
            _current_temp = round(
                TemperatureUnits.to_fahrenheit(_current_temp, TemperatureUnits.CELSIUS)
            )

        self.state_chamber_1.set_state(
            cook_status=self.status_map[resp_model.cookStatus],
            cook_time=cook_step.cookSetTime,
            cook_last_time=cook_step.cookLastTime,
            cook_temp=cook_step.cookTemp,
            cook_mode=cook_step.mode,
            # preheatSetTime is 0 when the cook has no preheat step.
            preheat_set_time=resp_model.preheatSetTime or None,
            preheat_last_time=resp_model.preheatLastTime,
            current_temp=_current_temp,
            recipe=cook_step.recipeName or None,
            total_last_time=resp_model.totalTimeRemaining,
        )

    async def end(
        self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
    ) -> bool:
        if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
            return False
        payload_method = 'endCook'
        resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
            payload_method=payload_method,
            payload_update=self._payload_update(),
        )
        r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'end', self, resp)
        if r is None:
            return False
        self.state.set_standby()
        return True

    async def set_mode_from_recipe(
        self,
        recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe,
        *,
        chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
    ) -> bool:
        if self._validate_chamber(chamber) is None:
            return False
        prepared = self._prepare_recipe(recipe)
        if prepared is None:
            return False
        recipe = prepared
        payload_method = 'startCook'
        data = self._build_cook_request(recipe)
        resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
            payload_method=payload_method,
            data=data.to_dict(),
            payload_update=self._payload_update(),
        )
        r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'set_mode_from_recipe', self, resp)
        if r is None:
            return False
        cook_time = self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.cook_time)
        preheat_time = (
            self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.preheat_time)
            if recipe.preheat_time
            else None
        )
        self.state.set_state(
            # A program with preheat runs the preheat phase first.
            cook_status=AirFryerCookStatus.HEATING
            if preheat_time
            else AirFryerCookStatus.COOKING,
            cook_time=cook_time,
            cook_last_time=cook_time,
            cook_temp=recipe.target_temp,
            cook_mode=recipe.cook_mode,
            preheat_set_time=preheat_time,
            preheat_last_time=preheat_time,
        )
        return True

    async def set_mode(
        self,
        cook_time: int,
        cook_temp: int,
        *,
        temp_unit: TemperatureUnits | str | None = None,
        preheat_time: int | None = None,
        cook_mode: str | None = None,
        chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
    ) -> bool:
        unit = self._resolve_temp_unit(temp_unit)
        if unit is None:
            return False
        recipe = self._recipe_for_set_mode(
            cook_time, cook_temp, cook_mode, preheat_time, temp_unit=unit
        )
        if recipe is None:
            return False
        return await self.set_mode_from_recipe(recipe, chamber=chamber)

    resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
        payload_method=payload_method,
        data=data.to_dict(),
        payload_update=self._payload_update(),
    )
    r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'set_mode_from_recipe', self, resp)
    if r is None:
        return False
    cook_time = self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.cook_time)
    preheat_time = (
        self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.preheat_time)
        if recipe.preheat_time
        else None
    )
    self.state.set_state(
        # A program with preheat runs the preheat phase first.
        cook_status=AirFryerCookStatus.HEATING
        if preheat_time
        else AirFryerCookStatus.COOKING,
        cook_time=cook_time,
        cook_last_time=cook_time,
        cook_temp=recipe.target_temp,
        cook_mode=recipe.cook_mode,
        preheat_set_time=preheat_time,
        preheat_last_time=preheat_time,
    )
    return True

Start a cook with the given time and temperature.

cook_temp is converted to the device unit if needed, rounded to the cook mode's step (see round_temperature()) and checked against that mode's limits (see temp_limits()). Out of range logs a warning and returns False without a request. On success the chamber state is set locally from the request; call update() for the device's reported state.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default cook_time int

The cooking time in seconds, at least 1 (60 on the CS137/CS158, whose API uses minutes and truncates to whole minutes). A shorter time returns False without a request. A mode's time_limits, where declared, also apply; a time outside them returns False without a request. Other modes have no upper limit.

The unit of cook_temp; defaults to the device's current temp_unit. An unrecognised unit string returns False without a request.

The preheating time in seconds, if any. Used only on fryers with the PREHEAT feature: dropped on the CAF-P583S and ignored on the dual-chamber fryers. On fryers with preheat it must be 0 or at least one API time unit (60 seconds on the CS137/CS158); otherwise False without a request.

None cook_mode str | None

Cook mode to use, an AirFryerCookModes key or the API mode string (see get_cook_mode()). Its recipe ID, name and type are sent. None uses the default preset. A mode the fryer does not have returns False without a request.

None chamber AirFryerChamber | int

The chamber to cook in. Default is CHAMBER_1. A chamber not in supported_chambers returns False without a request.

CHAMBER_1

async def set_mode(
    self,
    cook_time: int,
    cook_temp: int,
    *,
    temp_unit: TemperatureUnits | str | None = None,
    preheat_time: int | None = None,
    cook_mode: str | None = None,
    chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
) -> bool:
    unit = self._resolve_temp_unit(temp_unit)
    if unit is None:
        return False
    recipe = self._recipe_for_set_mode(
        cook_time, cook_temp, cook_mode, preheat_time, temp_unit=unit
    )
    if recipe is None:
        return False
    return await self.set_mode_from_recipe(recipe, chamber=chamber)

class VeSyncDualBlazeFryer(VeSyncTurboBlazeFryer):
    """Cosori Dual Blaze Air Fryer Class (CAF-P583S).

    Uses the TurboBlaze bypassV2 protocol with the request shape from the
    CAF-P583S-KUS capture (2025-05-21): ``startCook`` data uses ``accountID``
    (not ``accountId``) and sends ``hasLinkage`` False, and every payload
    carries ``subDeviceNo`` and ``subDeviceType``. The KEU variant has no
    capture and is assumed to match. The P583S has no preheat, so
    ``preheat_time`` is dropped with a debug log.
    """

    __slots__ = ()

    def _payload_update(self) -> dict | None:
        return dict(BYPASSV2_SUB_DEVICE_PAYLOAD)

    def _build_cook_request(self, recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe) -> RequestBaseModel:
        cook_req = self._cook_request_dict(recipe)
        cook_req['accountID'] = cook_req.pop('accountId')
        cook_req['hasLinkage'] = False
        return models.FryerDualBlazeRequestData.from_dict(cook_req)

Cosori Dual Air Fryer Class (CAF-TF101S, CAF-TF102S, CAF-DC111S).

Chambers are selected with AirFryerChamber:

  • CHAMBER_1 / CHAMBER_2: one chamber (left/right on the TF101S/TF102S, upper/lower on the DC111S).
  • WHOLE: the merged basket with the divider removed (TwinFry models only, WHOLE_CHAMBER feature).
  • BOTH: both chambers with identical settings, sent as the app's Sync mode (workChamber 4, syncType 2: both chambers finish together).

During a Sync cook with different times, the DC111S reports the chamber that waits to start as AirFryerCookStatus.HOLD. Its wait counts down only while the other chamber is cooking. set_chamber_modes() starts a Sync cook with different settings per chamber, on fryers with the CHAMBER_MODES feature; other fryers need the app or the fryer for that.

The device has no preheat, pause, or resume API: preheat_time and a recipe's preheat_time are ignored, and stop() / resume() return False. Pausing is handled physically by pulling the basket out, which triggers a cookStop or pullOut state. Pushing the basket back in resumes cooking automatically. The status has no temperature reading, so current_temp stays None.

Device details.

required manager VeSync

State for chamber 1 (left) or whole.

State for chamber 2 (right).

Read-only. True only for the app's Sync mode (syncType 2). Set by update(); a successful set_mode() / set_mode_from_recipe() sets it True for BOTH and False for any other chamber, a successful set_chamber_modes() sets it True for SYNC and False otherwise, and end(BOTH) sets it False.

work_chamber AirFryerChamber | None

Read-only. Chamber the device reports as active (workChamber); None when idle. Set by update(). A successful WHOLE start sets WHOLE, any other start clears a WHOLE value, and ending WHOLE or BOTH clears it. end(CHAMBER_1) while it is WHOLE ends the whole basket.

A failed poll leaves both chamber states unchanged, apart from the connection status and update time, which both chambers take from the response. A chamber with an unknown cookStatus keeps its state.

class VeSyncDualAirFryer(BypassV2Mixin, VeSyncFryer):
    """Cosori Dual Air Fryer Class (CAF-TF101S, CAF-TF102S, CAF-DC111S).

    Chambers are selected with ``AirFryerChamber``:

    - ``CHAMBER_1`` / ``CHAMBER_2``: one chamber (left/right on the
      TF101S/TF102S, upper/lower on the DC111S).
    - ``WHOLE``: the merged basket with the divider removed (TwinFry models
      only, ``WHOLE_CHAMBER`` feature).
    - ``BOTH``: both chambers with identical settings, sent as the app's Sync
      mode (``workChamber`` 4, ``syncType`` 2: both chambers finish together).

    During a Sync cook with different times, the DC111S reports the chamber
    that waits to start as ``AirFryerCookStatus.HOLD``. Its wait counts down
    only while the other chamber is cooking. ``set_chamber_modes()`` starts
    a Sync cook with different settings per chamber, on fryers with the
    ``CHAMBER_MODES`` feature; other fryers need the app or the fryer for that.

    The device has no preheat, pause, or resume API: ``preheat_time`` and a
    recipe's ``preheat_time`` are ignored, and ``stop()`` / ``resume()``
    return False. Pausing is handled physically by pulling the basket out,
    which triggers a ``cookStop`` or ``pullOut`` state. Pushing the basket
    back in resumes cooking automatically. The status has no temperature
    reading, so ``current_temp`` stays None.

    Args:
        details (ResponseDeviceDetailsModel): Device details.
        manager (VeSync): Manager class.
        feature_map (AirFryerMap): Device feature map.

    Attributes:
        state_chamber_1 (FryerState): State for chamber 1 (left) or whole.
        state_chamber_2 (FryerState): State for chamber 2 (right).
        sync_chambers (bool): Read-only. True only for the app's Sync mode
            (``syncType`` 2). Set by ``update()``; a successful
            ``set_mode()`` / ``set_mode_from_recipe()`` sets it True for
            ``BOTH`` and False for any other chamber, a successful
            ``set_chamber_modes()`` sets it True for ``SYNC`` and False
            otherwise, and ``end(BOTH)`` sets it False.
        work_chamber (AirFryerChamber | None): Read-only. Chamber the device
            reports as active (``workChamber``); None when idle. Set by
            ``update()``. A successful ``WHOLE`` start sets ``WHOLE``, any other
            start clears a ``WHOLE`` value, and ending ``WHOLE`` or ``BOTH``
            clears it. ``end(CHAMBER_1)`` while it is ``WHOLE`` ends the whole
            basket.

    A failed poll leaves both chamber states unchanged, apart from the
    connection status and update time, which both chambers take from the
    response. A chamber with an unknown ``cookStatus`` keeps its state.
    """

    __slots__ = ()

    def _get_sync_type(self, chamber: AirFryerChamber) -> AirFryerSyncType:
        """Return the API syncType value for a validated chamber."""
        if chamber == AirFryerChamber.BOTH:
            return AirFryerSyncType.SYNC
        return AirFryerSyncType.OFF

    def _set_reported_sync(self, value: bool) -> None:
        """Set ``sync_chambers`` on both chamber states."""
        self.state_chamber_1.sync_chambers = value
        self.state_chamber_2.sync_chambers = value

    def _set_reported_work_chamber(self, value: AirFryerChamber | None) -> None:
        """Set ``work_chamber`` on both chamber states."""
        self.state_chamber_1.work_chamber = value
        self.state_chamber_2.work_chamber = value

    async def get_details(self) -> None:
        """Get device details from the API.

        Polls ``getAirfryerMultiStatus`` and updates state for each chamber.
        """
        resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
            payload_method='getAirfryerMultiStatus',
            payload_update=dict(BYPASSV2_SUB_DEVICE_PAYLOAD),
        )
        resp_model = process_bypassv2_result(
            self,
            logger,
            'get_details',
            resp,
            models.FryerDualMultiStatusResult,
        )

        # process_bypassv2_result only updates self.state (chamber 1).
        self.state_chamber_2.last_update_ts = self.state_chamber_1.last_update_ts
        self.state_chamber_2.connection_status = self.state_chamber_1.connection_status
        if resp_model is None:
            return

        if resp_model.tempUnit is not None:
            self.temp_unit = resp_model.tempUnit

        # Update sync state and active chamber from API response
        self._set_reported_sync(resp_model.syncType == AirFryerSyncType.SYNC)
        try:
            self._set_reported_work_chamber(AirFryerChamber(resp_model.workChamber))
        except ValueError:
            if resp_model.workChamber != 0:
                logger.debug(
                    'Unknown workChamber %s for %s',
                    resp_model.workChamber,
                    self.device_name,
                )
            self._set_reported_work_chamber(None)

        # Track which chambers were updated
        updated_chambers: set[AirFryerChamber] = set()

        for status_item in resp_model.statusList:
            ch = self._apply_chamber_status(status_item)
            if ch is not None:
                updated_chambers.add(ch)

        # Set any chambers not in the response to standby. Whole-chamber
        # status is reported as a single chamber 3 item, so chamber 2 idles.
        if (
            AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1 not in updated_chambers
            and AirFryerChamber.WHOLE not in updated_chambers
        ):
            self.state_chamber_1.set_standby()
        if AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_2 not in updated_chambers:
            self.state_chamber_2.set_standby()

        self._pause_held_chamber(self.state_chamber_1, self.state_chamber_2)
        self._pause_held_chamber(self.state_chamber_2, self.state_chamber_1)

    @staticmethod
    def _pause_held_chamber(held: FryerState, other: FryerState) -> None:
        """Stop a held chamber's countdown while the other chamber is not cooking.

        During a Sync cook the held chamber's wait is the other chamber's
        remaining time minus its own cook time, so it only advances while the
        other chamber cooks (DC111S captures: the wait stays put while the
        other chamber is in ``cookStop``).
        """
        if (
            held.cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.HOLD
            and other.cook_status != AirFryerCookStatus.COOKING
        ):
            held.last_timestamp = None

    def _apply_chamber_status(
        self, status_item: models.FryerDualChamberStatusItem
    ) -> AirFryerChamber | None:
        """Update one chamber's state from a ``statusList`` item.

        A chamber with an unknown ``cookStatus`` keeps its last state but still
        counts as reported.

        Args:
            status_item (models.FryerDualChamberStatusItem): The status item.

        Returns:
            AirFryerChamber | None: The reported chamber, or None (after a
            warning) if the chamber number is unknown.
        """
        chamber_state = self.get_chamber_state(status_item.chamber)
        if chamber_state is None:
            logger.warning(
                'Unknown chamber %s in status for %s',
                status_item.chamber,
                self.device_name,
            )
            return None
        ch = AirFryerChamber(status_item.chamber)
        if status_item.cookStatus not in self.status_map:
            logger.warning(
                'Unknown cook status %s for %s chamber %d, keeping its last state',
                status_item.cookStatus,
                self.device_name,
                status_item.chamber,
            )
        elif status_item.cookStatus == AirFryerCookStatus.STANDBY.value:
            chamber_state.set_standby()
        else:
            chamber_state.set_state(
                cook_status=self.status_map[status_item.cookStatus],
                cook_time=status_item.cookSetTime,
                cook_last_time=status_item.currentRemainingTime,
                cook_temp=status_item.cookTemp,
                cook_mode=status_item.mode,
                recipe=status_item.recipeName or None,
                total_last_time=status_item.totalTimeRemaining,
            )
        return ch

    async def end(
        self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
    ) -> bool:
        """End the current cooking session.

        Args:
            chamber (AirFryerChamber | int): Chamber to end. ``BOTH`` ends
                both chambers. ``CHAMBER_1`` during a whole-basket cook
                (``work_chamber`` ``WHOLE``) ends the whole basket. During a
                Sync cook (``sync_chambers``), one chamber sends an end for
                that chamber only.

        Returns:
            bool: True on success, and the ended chamber state(s) are set to
            standby. False without a request for an unsupported chamber.
        """
        member = self._validate_chamber(chamber)
        if member is None:
            return False
        if (
            member == AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
            and self.work_chamber == AirFryerChamber.WHOLE
        ):
            logger.debug(
                '%s is cooking in the whole basket; ending WHOLE', self.device_name
            )
            member = AirFryerChamber.WHOLE
        if self.sync_chambers and member in (
            AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
            AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_2,
        ):
            logger.debug(
                '%s is in Sync mode; end(%s) ends one chamber, '
                'pass AirFryerChamber.BOTH to end both',
                self.device_name,
                member.name,
            )
        resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
            payload_method='endCook',
            data={'chamber': int(member)},
            payload_update=dict(BYPASSV2_SUB_DEVICE_PAYLOAD),
        )
        r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'end', self, resp)
        if r is None:
            return False

        if member == AirFryerChamber.BOTH:
            self.state_chamber_1.set_standby()
            self.state_chamber_2.set_standby()
            self._set_reported_sync(False)
        else:
            self._chamber_state(member).set_standby()
        if member in (AirFryerChamber.WHOLE, AirFryerChamber.BOTH):
            self._set_reported_work_chamber(None)
        return True

    async def _pause_or_resume(
        self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int, method: str, name: str
    ) -> list[FryerState] | None:
        """Send pauseWork / resumeWork for a chamber.

        Returns the affected chamber states on success, None otherwise.
        """
        member = self._validate_chamber(chamber)
        if member is None:
            return None
        if AirFryerFeatures.RESUMABLE not in self.features:
            logger.info('%s not supported by this fryer.', name)
            return None
        if member == AirFryerChamber.WHOLE:
            logger.info('%s is not supported for the whole basket.', name)
            return None
        resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
            payload_method=method,
            data={'chamber': int(member)},
            payload_update=dict(BYPASSV2_SUB_DEVICE_PAYLOAD),
        )
        if Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, name, self, resp) is None:
            return None
        if member == AirFryerChamber.BOTH:
            return [self.state_chamber_1, self.state_chamber_2]
        return [self._chamber_state(member)]

    async def stop(
        self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
    ) -> bool:
        """Pause cooking in a chamber (``pauseWork``).

        Needs the ``RESUMABLE`` feature. ``BOTH`` pauses both chambers in one
        request. During a Sync cook the other chamber's ``HOLD`` wait stops
        counting down too. The paused chamber reports ``cookStop`` and keeps
        its remaining time.

        Args:
            chamber (AirFryerChamber | int): Chamber to pause.

        Returns:
            bool: True on success.
        """
        states = await self._pause_or_resume(chamber, 'pauseWork', 'stop')
        if states is None:
            return False
        for state in states:
            if state.is_in_cook_mode:
                state.set_cook_stop_state()
        return True

    async def resume(
        self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
    ) -> bool:
        """Resume a paused chamber (``resumeWork``).

        Needs the ``RESUMABLE`` feature. ``BOTH`` resumes both chambers in one
        request. The remaining time carries over.

        Args:
            chamber (AirFryerChamber | int): Chamber to resume.

        Returns:
            bool: True on success.
        """
        states = await self._pause_or_resume(chamber, 'resumeWork', 'resume')
        if states is None:
            return False
        for state in states:
            if state.cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.COOK_STOP:
                state.set_cook_resume_state()
        return True

    def _build_cook_configs(
        self,
        recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe,
        chamber: AirFryerChamber,
    ) -> list[models.FryerDualCookConfig]:
        """Build cookConfigs list for startMultiCook request.

        Args:
            recipe: The recipe to cook.
            chamber: Validated chamber. ``BOTH`` gives configs for chambers
                1 and 2.

        Returns:
            List of FryerDualCookConfig for the API request.
        """
        config_dict = {
            'cookSetTime': self.convert_time_for_api(recipe.cook_time),
            'cookTemp': recipe.target_temp,
            'mode': recipe.cook_mode,
            'recipeId': recipe.recipe_id,
            'recipeName': recipe.recipe_name,
            'recipeType': recipe.recipe_type,
        }
        if AirFryerFeatures.COOK_CONFIG_SHAKE_TIME in self.features:
            config_dict['shakeTime'] = 0

        if chamber == AirFryerChamber.BOTH:
            return [
                models.FryerDualCookConfig.from_dict({**config_dict, 'chamber': 1}),
                models.FryerDualCookConfig.from_dict({**config_dict, 'chamber': 2}),
            ]
        return [
            models.FryerDualCookConfig.from_dict(
                {**config_dict, 'chamber': int(chamber)}
            ),
        ]

    async def set_mode_from_recipe(
        self,
        recipe: AirFryerPresetRecipe,
        *,
        chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
    ) -> bool:
        """Start cooking with a preset recipe.

        Args:
            recipe: The preset recipe to use. Its ``preheat_time`` is ignored.
            chamber (AirFryerChamber | int): Chamber to cook in. ``BOTH``
                cooks both chambers in sync.

        Returns:
            True if the command was successful.
        """
        member = self._validate_chamber(chamber)
        if member is None:
            return False
        prepared = self._prepare_recipe(recipe)
        if prepared is None:
            return False
        cook_configs = self._build_cook_configs(prepared, member)
        return await self._start_cook_configs(
            cook_configs, member, self._get_sync_type(member)
        )

    async def _start_cook_configs(
        self,
        configs: list[models.FryerDualCookConfig],
        chamber: AirFryerChamber,
        sync_type: AirFryerSyncType,
    ) -> bool:
        """Send validated configs to ``startMultiCook`` and update the state.

        Args:
            configs: The chamber configs to start.
            chamber: Validated chamber sent as ``workChamber``.
            sync_type: The ``syncType`` to send.

        Returns:
            True if the command was successful.
        """
        start_data = models.FryerDualStartCookData.from_dict(
            {
                'accountId': self.manager.account_id,
                'cookConfigs': [c.to_dict() for c in configs],
                # readyStart False starts the cook at once; True waits for the
                # start button.
                'readyStart': False,
                'syncType': int(sync_type),
                'tempUnit': self.temp_unit.code,
                'workChamber': int(chamber),
            }
        )

        resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
            payload_method='startMultiCook',
            data=start_data.to_dict(),
            payload_update=dict(BYPASSV2_SUB_DEVICE_PAYLOAD),
        )
        r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'set_mode_from_recipe', self, resp)
        if r is None:
            return False

        self._set_reported_sync(sync_type == AirFryerSyncType.SYNC)
        if chamber == AirFryerChamber.WHOLE:
            self._set_reported_work_chamber(AirFryerChamber.WHOLE)
        elif self.work_chamber == AirFryerChamber.WHOLE:
            self._set_reported_work_chamber(None)
        # In a Sync cook with different times, the shorter chamber waits for the
        # difference so both finish together.
        longest = max(config.cookSetTime for config in configs)
        separate_times = sync_type == AirFryerSyncType.SYNC and any(
            config.cookSetTime != longest for config in configs
        )
        for config in configs:
            wait_time = longest - config.cookSetTime if separate_times else 0
            # readyStart is False, so the cook starts without the start button.
            self._chamber_state(AirFryerChamber(config.chamber)).set_state(
                cook_status=(
                    AirFryerCookStatus.HOLD if wait_time else AirFryerCookStatus.COOKING
                ),
                cook_time=config.cookSetTime,
                cook_last_time=wait_time or config.cookSetTime,
                total_last_time=longest if separate_times else None,
                cook_temp=config.cookTemp,
                cook_mode=config.mode,
                recipe=config.recipeName,
            )
        return True

    async def set_chamber_modes(
        self,
        chamber_1: AirFryerPresetRecipe,
        chamber_2: AirFryerPresetRecipe | None = None,
        *,
        sync_type: AirFryerSyncType = AirFryerSyncType.SYNC,
    ) -> bool:
        if AirFryerFeatures.CHAMBER_MODES not in self.features:
            return await super().set_chamber_modes(
                chamber_1, chamber_2, sync_type=sync_type
            )
        if sync_type not in (
            AirFryerSyncType.OFF,
            AirFryerSyncType.SYNC,
            AirFryerSyncType.MATCH,
        ):
            logger.warning(
                'Invalid chamber sync type %s for %s', sync_type, self.device_name
            )
            return False
        if (chamber_2 is None) != (sync_type == AirFryerSyncType.MATCH):
            logger.warning('Invalid chamber recipe combination for %s', self.device_name)
            return False

        if first is None:
            return False
        second = first if chamber_2 is None else self._prepare_recipe(chamber_2)
        if second is None:
            return False
        configs = [
            *self._build_cook_configs(first, AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1),
            *self._build_cook_configs(second, AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_2),
        ]
        return await self._start_cook_configs(configs, AirFryerChamber.BOTH, sync_type)

                cooks both chambers in sync.

            cook_time, cook_temp, cook_mode, None, temp_unit=unit

async def get_details(self) -> None:
    """Get device details from the API.

    Polls ``getAirfryerMultiStatus`` and updates state for each chamber.
    """
    resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
        payload_method='getAirfryerMultiStatus',
        payload_update=dict(BYPASSV2_SUB_DEVICE_PAYLOAD),
    )
    resp_model = process_bypassv2_result(
        self,
        logger,
        'get_details',
        resp,
        models.FryerDualMultiStatusResult,
    )

    # process_bypassv2_result only updates self.state (chamber 1).
    self.state_chamber_2.last_update_ts = self.state_chamber_1.last_update_ts
    self.state_chamber_2.connection_status = self.state_chamber_1.connection_status
    if resp_model is None:
        return

    if resp_model.tempUnit is not None:
        self.temp_unit = resp_model.tempUnit

    # Update sync state and active chamber from API response
    self._set_reported_sync(resp_model.syncType == AirFryerSyncType.SYNC)
    try:
        self._set_reported_work_chamber(AirFryerChamber(resp_model.workChamber))
    except ValueError:
        if resp_model.workChamber != 0:
            logger.debug(
                'Unknown workChamber %s for %s',
                resp_model.workChamber,
                self.device_name,
            )
        self._set_reported_work_chamber(None)

    # Track which chambers were updated
    updated_chambers: set[AirFryerChamber] = set()

    for status_item in resp_model.statusList:
        ch = self._apply_chamber_status(status_item)
        if ch is not None:
            updated_chambers.add(ch)

    # Set any chambers not in the response to standby. Whole-chamber
    # status is reported as a single chamber 3 item, so chamber 2 idles.
    if (
        AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1 not in updated_chambers
        and AirFryerChamber.WHOLE not in updated_chambers
    ):
        self.state_chamber_1.set_standby()
    if AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_2 not in updated_chambers:
        self.state_chamber_2.set_standby()

    self._pause_held_chamber(self.state_chamber_1, self.state_chamber_2)
    self._pause_held_chamber(self.state_chamber_2, self.state_chamber_1)

async def end(
    self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
) -> bool:
    """End the current cooking session.

    Args:
        chamber (AirFryerChamber | int): Chamber to end. ``BOTH`` ends
            both chambers. ``CHAMBER_1`` during a whole-basket cook
            (``work_chamber`` ``WHOLE``) ends the whole basket. During a
            Sync cook (``sync_chambers``), one chamber sends an end for
            that chamber only.

    Returns:
        bool: True on success, and the ended chamber state(s) are set to
        standby. False without a request for an unsupported chamber.
    """
    member = self._validate_chamber(chamber)
    if member is None:
        return False
    if (
        member == AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
        and self.work_chamber == AirFryerChamber.WHOLE
    ):
        logger.debug(
            '%s is cooking in the whole basket; ending WHOLE', self.device_name
        )
        member = AirFryerChamber.WHOLE
    if self.sync_chambers and member in (
        AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1,
        AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_2,
    ):
        logger.debug(
            '%s is in Sync mode; end(%s) ends one chamber, '
            'pass AirFryerChamber.BOTH to end both',
            self.device_name,
            member.name,
        )
    resp = await self.call_bypassv2_api(
        payload_method='endCook',
        data={'chamber': int(member)},
        payload_update=dict(BYPASSV2_SUB_DEVICE_PAYLOAD),
    )
    r = Helpers.process_dev_response(logger, 'end', self, resp)
    if r is None:
        return False

    if member == AirFryerChamber.BOTH:
        self.state_chamber_1.set_standby()
        self.state_chamber_2.set_standby()
        self._set_reported_sync(False)
    else:
        self._chamber_state(member).set_standby()
    if member in (AirFryerChamber.WHOLE, AirFryerChamber.BOTH):
        self._set_reported_work_chamber(None)
    return True

async def stop(
    self, chamber: AirFryerChamber | int = AirFryerChamber.CHAMBER_1
) -> bool:
    """Pause cooking in a chamber (``pauseWork``).

    Needs the ``RESUMABLE`` feature. ``BOTH`` pauses both chambers in one
    request. During a Sync cook the other chamber's ``HOLD`` wait stops
    counting down too. The paused chamber reports ``cookStop`` and keeps
    its remaining time.

    Args:
        chamber (AirFryerChamber | int): Chamber to pause.

    Returns:
        bool: True on success.
    """
    states = await self._pause_or_resume(chamber, 'pauseWork', 'stop')
    if states is None:
        return False
    for state in states:
        if state.is_in_cook_mode:
            state.set_cook_stop_state()
    return True

    """Resume a paused chamber (``resumeWork``).

class FryerState(DeviceState):
    """State class for Air Fryer devices.

    Each FryerState instance represents a single cooking chamber. For single
    chamber fryers, ``state`` is set to ``state_chamber_1``. For dual chamber
    fryers, ``state_chamber_1`` and ``state_chamber_2`` are used independently.

    Times are in SECONDS, whatever the device's API uses; ``set_state()``
    converts API values with the device's ``convert_time_for_state()``.
    Temperatures are in the device's ``temp_unit``.

    Args:
        device (VeSyncFryer): The device object.
        details (ResponseDeviceDetailsModel): The device details.
        feature_map (AirFryerMap): The feature map for the device.

    Attributes:
        active_time (int): Active time of device, defaults to None.
        connection_status (str): Connection status of device.
        device (VeSyncFryer): Device object.
        device_status (str): Device status.
        features (list[str]): ``AirFryerFeatures`` values from the device map.
        time_units (TimeUnits): The time unit of the device's API. State times
            are always in seconds.
        cook_status (AirFryerCookStatus | None): The current cooking status.
        cook_mode (str | None): The API mode string of the current cook (for
            example ``'AirFry'`` or ``'poultry'``), not an ``AirFryerCookModes``
            key.
        temp_unit (TemperatureUnits): Unit for all temperatures in this state
            (read-through to the device's ``temp_unit``).
        current_temp (int | None): The current temperature in ``temp_unit`` units.
        cook_set_temp (int | None): The set cooking temperature in ``temp_unit``
            units.
        cook_set_time (int | None): The set cooking time in seconds.
        cook_last_time (int | None): The remaining cooking time in seconds at
            the last update or command. ``cook_time_remaining`` counts it down.
        last_timestamp (datetime | None): When the remaining times were last
            refreshed. Set each time ``cook_status`` is set to cooking,
            heating or hold (each update while running), None after standby, a
            stop, or a ``HOLD`` poll while the other chamber is not cooking.
            Used to count the remaining times down.
        preheat_set_time (int | None): The set preheating time in seconds.
        preheat_last_time (int | None): The remaining preheating time in
            seconds at the last update or command. ``preheat_time_remaining``
            counts it down.
        total_last_time (int | None): Device-reported total remaining time
            (preheat plus cook) in seconds at the last update; None when the
            device does not report it (CS158) or after a local command until
            the next update.
        recipe (str | None): The recipe name the device reports. A local
            command sets it only on dual-chamber fryers.
        ready_start (bool): Not used by the library; always False.
        sync_chambers (bool): True only when the device reports the app's Sync
            mode (``syncType`` 2). Dual-chamber fryers only, always False
            otherwise: set by ``update()``, by a successful ``set_mode()`` /
            ``set_mode_from_recipe()`` (True only for ``BOTH``) and by
            ``end(BOTH)`` (False). The same on both chamber states.
        work_chamber (AirFryerChamber | None): Chamber the device reports as
            active (``workChamber``); None when idle or not reported, and
            always None on single-chamber fryers. Set by ``update()``; a
            successful ``WHOLE`` start sets it to ``WHOLE``, any other start
            clears a ``WHOLE`` value, and ending ``WHOLE`` or ``BOTH`` clears
            it. The same on both chamber states.

    Note:
        Device classes call ``set_state()`` with the API response or the sent
        request, ``set_standby()`` to clear the state, and the stop and
        resume helpers for local pause and resume. Setting a running
        ``cook_status`` (cooking, heating or hold) updates ``last_timestamp``. A
        failed or unreadable poll leaves the state unchanged.
    """

    __slots__ = (
        '_cook_status',
        'cook_last_time',
        'cook_mode',
        'cook_set_temp',
        'cook_set_time',
        'current_temp',
        'last_timestamp',
        'preheat_last_time',
        'preheat_set_time',
        'ready_start',
        'recipe',
        'sync_chambers',
        'time_units',
        'total_last_time',
        'work_chamber',
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        device: VeSyncFryer,
        details: ResponseDeviceDetailsModel,
        feature_map: AirFryerMap,
    ) -> None:
        """Initialize FryerState."""
        super().__init__(device, details, feature_map)
        self.device: VeSyncFryer = device
        self.features: list[str] = feature_map.features
        self.time_units: TimeUnits = feature_map.time_units
        self.sync_chambers: bool = False
        self.work_chamber: AirFryerChamber | None = None
        # Cooking state attributes
        self._cook_status: AirFryerCookStatus | None = None
        self.current_temp: int | None = None
        self.cook_mode: str | None = None
        self.cook_set_temp: int | None = None
        self.cook_set_time: int | None = None
        self.cook_last_time: int | None = None
        self.preheat_set_time: int | None = None
        self.preheat_last_time: int | None = None
        self.total_last_time: int | None = None
        self.last_timestamp: datetime | None = None
        self.recipe: str | None = None
        self.ready_start: bool = False

    @property
    def temp_unit(self) -> TemperatureUnits:
        """Return the unit for all temperatures in this state.

        This is the device-level unit; all state temperatures
        (``current_temp``, ``cook_set_temp``) are expressed in this unit.
        """
        return self.device.temp_unit

    @property
    def is_in_preheat_mode(self) -> bool:
        """Return True if the fryer is in preheat mode.

        A pulled-out basket counts as preheat only while preheat time remains.
        """
        return self.cook_status in PREHEAT_STATUSES or (
            self.cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.PULL_OUT
            and bool(self.preheat_last_time)
        )

    @property
    def is_in_cook_mode(self) -> bool:
        """Return True if the fryer is in cook mode."""
        return self.cook_status in COOK_STATUSES or (
            self.cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.PULL_OUT and not self.preheat_last_time
        )

    @property
    def is_cooking(self) -> bool:
        """Return True if the fryer is currently running in cook mode."""
        return self.cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.COOKING

    @property
    def is_preheating(self) -> bool:
        """Return True if the fryer is currently running in preheat mode."""
        return self.cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.HEATING

    @property
    def is_running(self) -> bool:
        """Return True if the fryer is running (cooking or preheating)."""
        return self.is_cooking or self.is_preheating

    @property
    def can_resume(self) -> bool:
        """Return True if the status is paused (cook or preheat stop).

        Only the CS137/CS158 implements ``resume()``.
        """
        return self.cook_status in RESUMABLE_STATUSES

    @property
    def cook_status(self) -> AirFryerCookStatus | None:
        """Return the current cooking status."""
        return self._cook_status

    @cook_status.setter
    def cook_status(self, value: AirFryerCookStatus | None) -> None:
        """Set the current cooking status.

        Automatically updates ``last_timestamp`` when setting a running state.

        Args:
            value (AirFryerCookStatus | None): The cooking status to set.
        """
        if value in RUNNING_STATUSES:
            self.last_timestamp = datetime.now(tz=UTC)
        self._cook_status = value

    @property
    def preheat_time_remaining(self) -> int | None:
        """Return the remaining preheat time in seconds."""
        if not self.is_in_preheat_mode:
            return None
        if self.cook_status in [
            AirFryerCookStatus.PREHEAT_STOP,
            AirFryerCookStatus.PULL_OUT,
        ]:
            return self.preheat_last_time
        if self.preheat_last_time is not None and self.last_timestamp is not None:
            return max(
                0,
                self.preheat_last_time
                - int((datetime.now(UTC) - self.last_timestamp).total_seconds()),
            )
        return None

    @property
    def cook_time_remaining(self) -> int | None:
        """Return the remaining cook time in seconds.

        In ``HOLD`` (dual-chamber Sync cook), this is the wait before the
        chamber starts cooking. It counts down only while the other chamber
        cooks; with no ``last_timestamp`` it is the reported wait.
        """
        if not self.is_in_cook_mode:
            return None
        if self.cook_status in [
            AirFryerCookStatus.PULL_OUT,
            AirFryerCookStatus.COOK_STOP,
            AirFryerCookStatus.READY,
        ]:
            return self.cook_last_time
        if self.cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.HOLD and self.last_timestamp is None:
            return self.cook_last_time

        if self.cook_last_time is not None and self.last_timestamp is not None:
            return max(
                0,
                self.cook_last_time
                - int((datetime.now(UTC) - self.last_timestamp).total_seconds()),
            )
        return None

    @property
    def total_time_remaining(self) -> int | None:
        """Return the time until the cook finishes, in seconds.

        This is the value the app's finish time uses. It comes from the
        device's ``totalTimeRemaining`` where reported (counting down while
        cooking, preheating, or in ``HOLD`` while the other chamber cooks),
        else remaining preheat plus cook time. None in standby, and on the
        CS158 during preheat after an ``update()`` (it reports no cook time
        then).
        """
        if self.cook_status in (None, AirFryerCookStatus.STANDBY):
            return None
        if self.total_last_time is not None:
            if self.cook_status in RUNNING_STATUSES and self.last_timestamp is not None:
                elapsed = int((datetime.now(UTC) - self.last_timestamp).total_seconds())
                return max(0, self.total_last_time - elapsed)
            return self.total_last_time
        if self.is_in_preheat_mode:
            preheat = self.preheat_time_remaining
            cook = self.cook_last_time
            return None if preheat is None or cook is None else preheat + cook
        return self.cook_time_remaining if self.is_in_cook_mode else None

    def _clear_preheat(self) -> None:
        """Clear preheat status."""
        self.preheat_set_time = None
        self.preheat_last_time = None

    def set_standby(self) -> None:
        """Set the fryer state to standby and clear the cook values.

        Clears the temperatures, times, recipe, preheat and
        ``last_timestamp``. ``cook_mode``, ``sync_chambers`` and
        ``work_chamber`` are kept.

        This is to be called by device classes before updating the state from
        the API response to prevent stale data. The get_details API responses
        do not include all keys in every response depending on the status.
        """
        self.cook_status = AirFryerCookStatus.STANDBY
        self.current_temp = None
        self.cook_set_temp = None
        self.cook_set_time = None
        self.cook_last_time = None
        self.last_timestamp = None
        self.total_last_time = None
        self.recipe = None
        self._clear_preheat()

    def set_cook_stop_state(
        self,
        cook_set_time: int | None = None,
        cook_last_time: int | None = None,
        total_last_time: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Set the fryer state to cook stopped.

        Args:
            cook_set_time (int | None): The cooking time in seconds.
            cook_last_time (int | None): The remaining cook time in seconds,
                as reported by the API. None freezes the live remaining time.
            total_last_time (int | None): The device-reported total remaining
                time in seconds, or None when not reported.
        """
        if cook_last_time is None:
            # Read before the status changes, while it still counts down.
            cook_last_time = self.cook_time_remaining
        self._clear_preheat()
        self.cook_status = AirFryerCookStatus.COOK_STOP
        if cook_set_time is not None:
            self.cook_set_time = cook_set_time
        self.cook_last_time = cook_last_time
        self.total_last_time = total_last_time
        self.last_timestamp = None

    def set_preheat_stop_state(
        self,
        preheat_set_time: int | None = None,
        preheat_last_time: int | None = None,
        total_last_time: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Set the fryer state to preheat stopped.

        Args:
            preheat_set_time (int | None): The preheating time in seconds.
            preheat_last_time (int | None): The remaining preheat time in
                seconds, as reported by the API. None freezes the live
                remaining time.
            total_last_time (int | None): The device-reported total remaining
                time in seconds, or None when not reported.
        """
        if preheat_last_time is None:
            # Read before the status changes, while it still counts down.
            preheat_last_time = self.preheat_time_remaining
        self.cook_status = AirFryerCookStatus.PREHEAT_STOP
        if preheat_set_time is not None:
            self.preheat_set_time = preheat_set_time
        self.preheat_last_time = preheat_last_time
        self.total_last_time = total_last_time
        self.last_timestamp = None

    def set_preheat_resume_state(self, preheat_set_time: int | None = None) -> None:
        """Set the fryer state to preheat resumed.

        The remaining preheat time carries over: a paused preheat resumes
        from its frozen value and a running one keeps counting down.

        Args:
            preheat_set_time (int | None): The preheating time in seconds.
        """
        # Read before the status changes, which restamps last_timestamp.
        remaining = self.preheat_time_remaining
        total = self._carried_total()
        self.cook_status = AirFryerCookStatus.HEATING
        if preheat_set_time is not None:
            self.preheat_set_time = preheat_set_time
        self.preheat_last_time = remaining
        self.total_last_time = total

    def set_cook_resume_state(self) -> None:
        """Set the fryer state to cooking after a resume.

        The remaining cook time carries over: a paused cook resumes from its
        frozen value and a running one keeps counting down.
        """
        # Read before the status changes, which restamps last_timestamp.
        remaining = self.cook_time_remaining
        total = self._carried_total()
        self._clear_preheat()
        self.cook_status = AirFryerCookStatus.COOKING
        if remaining is not None:
            self.cook_last_time = remaining
        self.total_last_time = total

    def _carried_total(self) -> int | None:
        """Return the device-reported total to keep across a local resume."""
        if self.total_last_time is None:
            return None
        return self.total_time_remaining

    def set_state(  # noqa: PLR0913
        self,
        *,
        cook_status: AirFryerCookStatus,
        cook_time: int | None = None,
        cook_last_time: int | None = None,
        cook_temp: int | None = None,
        cook_mode: str | None = None,
        preheat_set_time: int | None = None,
        preheat_last_time: int | None = None,
        current_temp: int | None = None,
        recipe: str | None = None,
        total_last_time: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Set the cook state from an API response or after a command.

        Pass every value of the current cook state together. Time values are
        in device units and are converted to seconds. ``STANDBY`` and the stop
        statuses use the matching helpers. Otherwise a None ``cook_time``,
        ``cook_temp``, ``cook_mode``, ``current_temp`` or ``recipe`` keeps the
        stored value; a None ``cook_last_time`` keeps it except while heating
        (cleared); and a None ``preheat_set_time`` clears the preheat values
        unless the status is a preheat status.

        Args:
            cook_status (AirFryerCookStatus): The cooking status.
            cook_time (int | None): The cooking time in device units.
            cook_last_time (int | None): The remaining cooking time in device units.
            cook_temp (int | None): The cooking temperature in the device's
                ``temp_unit``.
            cook_mode (str | None): The cooking mode.
            preheat_set_time (int | None): The preheating time in device units.
            preheat_last_time (int | None): The remaining preheat time in device units.
            current_temp (int | None): The current temperature in the device's
                ``temp_unit``.
            recipe (str | None): The recipe name or cooking mode.
            total_last_time (int | None): The device-reported total remaining
                time in device units. None (not reported, or a local command)
                clears the stored total.
        """
        # Stop/standby states delegate to helpers and return early
        if cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.STANDBY:
            self.set_standby()
            return

        if cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.COOK_STOP:
            self.set_cook_stop_state(
                cook_set_time=self._to_seconds(cook_time),
                cook_last_time=self._to_seconds(cook_last_time),
                total_last_time=self._to_seconds(total_last_time),
            )
            self._apply_settings(cook_temp, cook_mode, current_temp, recipe)
            return

        if cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.PREHEAT_STOP:
            self.set_preheat_stop_state(
                preheat_set_time=self._to_seconds(preheat_set_time),
                preheat_last_time=self._to_seconds(preheat_last_time),
                total_last_time=self._to_seconds(total_last_time),
            )
            self._apply_settings(cook_temp, cook_mode, current_temp, recipe)
            return

        # Set cook status (setter auto-updates last_timestamp for running statuses)
        self.cook_status = cook_status
        self.total_last_time = self._to_seconds(total_last_time)

        # Handle preheat attributes
        if preheat_set_time is not None:
            self.preheat_set_time = self.device.convert_time_for_state(preheat_set_time)
            self.preheat_last_time = (
                self.device.convert_time_for_state(preheat_last_time)
                if preheat_last_time is not None
                else self.preheat_set_time
            )
        elif cook_status not in PREHEAT_STATUSES:
            self._clear_preheat()

        # Handle cook time attributes
        if cook_time is not None:
            self.cook_set_time = self.device.convert_time_for_state(cook_time)
        if cook_last_time is not None:
            self.cook_last_time = self.device.convert_time_for_state(cook_last_time)
        elif cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.HEATING:
            self.cook_last_time = None

        self._apply_settings(cook_temp, cook_mode, current_temp, recipe)

    def _to_seconds(self, value: int | None) -> int | None:
        """Convert an API time in device units to seconds, keeping None."""
        if value is None:
            return None
        return self.device.convert_time_for_state(value)

    def _apply_settings(
        self,
        cook_temp: int | None,
        cook_mode: str | None,
        current_temp: int | None,
        recipe: str | None,
    ) -> None:
        """Set the reported cook settings that are not None."""
        if cook_temp is not None:
            self.cook_set_temp = cook_temp
        if cook_mode is not None:
            self.cook_mode = cook_mode
        if current_temp is not None:
            self.current_temp = current_temp
        if recipe is not None:
            self.recipe = recipe

    """
    # Stop/standby states delegate to helpers and return early
    if cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.STANDBY:
        self.set_standby()
        return

    if cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.COOK_STOP:
        self.set_cook_stop_state(
            cook_set_time=self._to_seconds(cook_time),
            cook_last_time=self._to_seconds(cook_last_time),
            total_last_time=self._to_seconds(total_last_time),
        )
        self._apply_settings(cook_temp, cook_mode, current_temp, recipe)
        return

    if cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.PREHEAT_STOP:
        self.set_preheat_stop_state(
            preheat_set_time=self._to_seconds(preheat_set_time),
            preheat_last_time=self._to_seconds(preheat_last_time),
            total_last_time=self._to_seconds(total_last_time),
        )
        self._apply_settings(cook_temp, cook_mode, current_temp, recipe)
        return

    # Set cook status (setter auto-updates last_timestamp for running statuses)
    self.cook_status = cook_status
    self.total_last_time = self._to_seconds(total_last_time)

    # Handle preheat attributes
    if preheat_set_time is not None:
        self.preheat_set_time = self.device.convert_time_for_state(preheat_set_time)
        self.preheat_last_time = (
            self.device.convert_time_for_state(preheat_last_time)
            if preheat_last_time is not None
            else self.preheat_set_time
        )
    elif cook_status not in PREHEAT_STATUSES:
        self._clear_preheat()

    # Handle cook time attributes
    if cook_time is not None:
        self.cook_set_time = self.device.convert_time_for_state(cook_time)
    if cook_last_time is not None:
        self.cook_last_time = self.device.convert_time_for_state(cook_last_time)
    elif cook_status == AirFryerCookStatus.HEATING:
        self.cook_last_time = None

    self._apply_settings(cook_temp, cook_mode, current_temp, recipe)
